ingredients: 2 medium apples, peeled, cored, and chopped
1 small sugar pumpkin (about 2 pounds), peeled, seeded, and cubed
Salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste
introduction: I first made this creamy roasted apple pumpkin soup a few falls ago when I wanted something warm and comforting but with a little twist. The usual pumpkin soups can sometimes feel one-note, but adding roasted apples and a touch of smoked paprika really lifts the flavor into something special. I love how the sweetness of the caramelized apples balances the earthiness of the pumpkin, while the paprika adds just the right hint of warmth without overpowering the dish. The secret I discovered was roasting the apples and pumpkin before blending, which deepens their flavors and gives the soup a velvety texture that feels luxurious but still homey. Plus, stirring in fresh Parmesan and cream at the end makes it silky smooth and rich, perfect for a cozy dinner for two. It’s simple enough to whip up on a weeknight but elegant enough to impress if you’re hosting. The finished soup is a beautiful warm orange, topped with a swirl of cream and a sprinkle of herbs that make it feel like fall in a bowl. I always find myself coming back to this recipe when the weather cools down—it’s just that good.
